name: agent-roster-docs
body:
The roster/upgrade documentation surfaces: `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`. Both state the distributed set as SEVEN agents including `implementation-phase-reviewer`, and `AGENTS.md` lists `implementation-phase-reviewer` solely among the distributed agents rather than among the agents the `agent-builder` generates — only `*-implementer` agents are generated.

This component carries the user-doc half of the release law: `README.md` states "…verify → merge → unguarded main rebuild. Push/tag remain human-approved", consistent with `requirements.requirement.push-tag-human-approved-release-only`.

A NARROW owner distinct from `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` (also `AGENTS.md`) and `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (`README.md` + `AGENTS.md`): those components are anchored to other concerns (the file-tool guidance; the frontend dependency contract), and reusing `frontend-dependency-docs` pulls its frontend-contract concern into this spine. This component is the repo guide plus the user README, rather than the `opencode-suite/` distribution itself.
